items.title: Maruti Suzuki’s SUV, MPV share of PV sales at 42% in H1 FY2027 with 455,692 units
items.summary: Passenger vehicle market leader Maruti Suzuki India has crossed the 1-million wholesales mark for the first time in the first-half of a fiscal in April-September 2026. The 10,80,240 units are a handsome 36% YoY increase and the result of a revival in demand for its cars and sedans following GST 2.0 price reductions and, importantly, the big jump in sales of its utility vehicles comprising SUVs and MPVs.

items.title: Navratri Sales Dip 5% on High Base Effect
items.summary: Vehicle retail sales during this year’s Navratri window slipped about 5% from last year, when the festival began on the same day that revised GST rates took effect, according to data released by the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA). Retailers sold 11,40,658 vehicles between 11 and 20 October 2026, against 12,01,480 in the 2025 window, a fall of 5.06%.
